from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCashPosition(BaseModel):
    """A specific cash position extracted from a single financial filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company in the filing")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The date of the financial period")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line item label used in the balance sheet (e.g., 'Cash', 'Cash and cash equivalents')")
    reported_value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the cash reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit scale of the reported value (e.g., 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_positions: list[CompanyCashPosition]
